description.zh: 中心化转投目的Project。如果配置中心化转投目的Project，则可以根据Project反向查询有多少规则配置了中心化转投到该centralProejct下。
description.en: The destination project for centralized data shipping. Specify this parameter to query the number of rules that are configured to ship data to this project.
The code of the log type.

description.zh: 实例ID。如果配置实例ID，则可以根据实例ID反向查询实例命中的规则，必须和productCode、dataCode结合使用。
description.en: The instance ID. Specify this parameter to query rules that match a specific instance. If you use this parameter, you must also specify productCode and dataCode.
The row from which the query starts. Default value: 0.
The name of the collection rule.
The code of the Alibaba Cloud service.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置的每页行数。默认值为 50，最多返回 100 个 规则信息。
description.en: The number of collection rules to return on each page. Default value: 50. Maximum value: 100.

title.zh: 列出云产品日志采集的采集规则

descriptions.zh: 该接口服务地址只能是华东 2（上海）、新加坡、河源专属云汽车合规（cn-heyuan-acdr-1）。
descriptions.en: This API operation is available only at the endpoints in the following regions: China (Shanghai), Singapore, and Heyuan Automotive Compliance Cloud (cn-heyuan-acdr-1).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sls list-collection-policies --product-code oss --data-code access_log --policy-name your_log_policy --size 50 --offset 0 --instance-id your-test-bucket1 --central-project your-central-project1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sls GET /collectionpolicy --region cn-hangzhou --centralProject 'your-central-project1' --productCode oss --instanceId 'your-test-bucket1' --size 50 --offset 0 --policyName your_log_policy --dataCode access_log --header "Content-Type=application/json"
